_comment: DICOM standard DocBook XML the generated tables were made from (src/dict/dictionary_data.inc, src/deid/deid_table.inc). Pinned by SHA-256; tools/ci/fetch_standard.py tries the archived edition URL first, then 'current' (where an edition lives until NEMA archives it). To move to a new edition: regenerate the tables, update edition and hashes here in the same commit.
